forces.title: Satellite communications poised for quantum communication market growth
forces.description: Telecom operators, including satellite communication providers, are forecast to significantly increase their market share in quantum communications, from 2-6% in 2023 to 16-26% by 2035. This growth is driven by the expansion of quantum networks and integration with cloud/cybersecurity offerings. For Satellite Communications, this represents a key upside as satellite-based Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) extends the reach of quantum-safe links, addressing limitations of fiber and catering to high-security demands over vast distances.
forces.source_title: Quantum is almost here: Are you and your systems ready?

demand_drivers.description: Increasing deployment of quantum communication infrastructure drives demand for related services.

demand_drivers.driver: Integration with public cloud and cybersecurity
demand_drivers.description: Growing need for enhanced security for high-value transactions and critical infrastructure, supported by cloud and cybersecurity platforms, drives quantum communication adoption.

new_opportunities.description: Leveraging satellite technology to overcome distance limitations of fiber-based QKD, enabling secure communications for high-value segments (government, finance, healthcare) that demand provable security over long distances, positioning satellite communications as a critical enabler in the future quantum network.

market_sizing.methodology: Forecast for telecom operators' market share in quantum communications to grow from 2-6% in 2023 to 16-26% by 2035. This implies a significant shift in market participation for the broader telecom sector. The opportunity for Satellite Communications specifically lies in leveraging satellite-based QKD to extend the reach of quantum-safe communications where fiber is limited.
